schema.text: When there is rain, wind or cold, how does it affect your usual trip?

options.text: It makes my journey less comfortable, but I do not change how I travel
It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. clothing or preparation)
It makes me change my route or travel at a different time
It makes me postpone or avoid some trips when possible
It makes me switch to a different mode of transport

en.#It makes me change my route or travel a: It makes me change my route or travel at a different time
en.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: It makes my journey less comfortable, but I do not change how I travel

en.#It makes me switch to a different mode: It makes me switch to a different mode of transport

it.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Mi porta a cambiare percorso o a spostarmi in un orario diverso
it.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Rende il mio spostamento meno confortevole, ma non cambio il modo in cui mi sposto
it.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Mi porta a rimandare o evitare alcuni spostamenti quando possibile
it.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Mi porta a scegliere una modalità di trasporto diversa
it.#When there is rain, wind or cold, how d: Quando c’è pioggia, vento o freddo, in che modo questo influisce sul tuo spostamento abituale?
it.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. c: Mi porta a modificare il modo in cui mi sposto (ad es. abbigliamento o preparazione)

fr.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Cela me fait changer d’itinéraire ou d’heure de déplacement
fr.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Cela rend mon trajet moins confortable, mais je ne change pas ma façon de me déplacer
fr.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Cela me fait reporter ou éviter certains déplacements quand c’est possible
fr.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Cela me fait choisir un autre mode de transport
fr.#When there is rain, wind or cold, how d: Quand il y a de la pluie, du vent ou du froid, comment cela affecte-t-il votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. c: Cela m’amène à adapter ma façon de me déplacer (par ex. vêtements ou préparation)

de.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Ich ändere meine Route oder fahre zu einer anderen Zeit
de.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Es macht meinen Weg weniger angenehm, aber ich ändere nicht, wie ich unterwegs bin
de.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Ich verschiebe oder vermeide manche Wege, wenn es möglich ist
de.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Ich wechsle zu einem anderen Verkehrsmittel
de.#When there is rain, wind or cold, how d: Wie wirken sich Regen, Wind oder Kälte auf Ihren üblichen Weg aus?
de.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. c: Ich passe an, wie ich unterwegs bin (z. B. Kleidung oder Vorbereitung)

tr.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Güzergâhımı değiştirmeme veya farklı bir saatte seyahat etmeme neden olur
tr.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Yolculuğumu daha az konforlu yapar ama nasıl seyahat ettiğimi değiştirmem
tr.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Mümkün olduğunda bazı yolculukları erteler veya yapmam
tr.#When there is rain, wind or cold, how d: Yağmur, rüzgâr veya soğuk olduğunda bu durum olağan yolculuğunuzu nasıl etkiliyor?
tr.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. c: Yolculuk biçimimi değiştirmeme neden oluyor (örneğin giyim veya hazırlık)

fa.#It makes me change my route or travel a: باعث می‌شود مسیر یا زمان سفر را تغییر دهم
fa.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: سفرم را کمتر راحت می‌کند، اما روش رفت‌وآمدم را تغییر نمی‌دهم
fa.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: اگر ممکن باشد بعضی سفرها را عقب می‌اندازم یا انجام نمی‌دهم
fa.#It makes me switch to a different mode: به روش دیگری برای رفت‌وآمد تغییر می‌دهم
fa.#When there is rain, wind or cold, how d: وقتی باران، باد یا سرما هست، چه تأثیری بر سفر معمول شما دارد؟
fa.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. c: باعث می‌شود شیوه رفت‌وآمدم را تنظیم کنم (مثلاً لباس یا آمادگی)

hu.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Megváltoztatom az útvonalat vagy más időpontban utazom
hu.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: Kényelmetlenebbé teszi az utat, de nem változtatom meg, hogyan közlekedem
hu.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: Ha lehet, elhalasztok vagy elkerülök bizonyos utakat
hu.#When there is rain, wind or cold, how d: Hogyan befolyásolja a szokásos útját az eső, a szél vagy a hideg?
hu.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. c: Miatta változtatok a közlekedésem módján (például öltözék vagy felkészülés)

ar.#It makes me change my route or travel a: يجعلني أغيّر الطريق أو أتنقل في وقت مختلف
ar.#It makes my journey less comfortable, b: يجعل الرحلة أقل راحة، لكنني لا أغيّر طريقة تنقلي
ar.#It makes me postpone or avoid some trip: يجعلني أؤجل بعض الرحلات أو أتجنبها عندما يكون ذلك ممكنًا
ar.#When there is rain, wind or cold, how d: عندما يكون هناك مطر أو رياح أو برد، كيف يؤثر ذلك في تنقّلك المعتاد؟
ar.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. c: يدفعني إلى تعديل طريقة تنقلي (مثل الملابس أو الاستعداد)
